answer: Stop sybils with a time-locked deposit: a newcomer locks 60 POA that only unlocks after 30 days of honest work. Steps: (1) lock 60 POA, (2) thread its public key and task history into a public ledger, (3) complete 10 tasks under peer review, and (4) fraud slashes the deposit while honest work releases it in full. Faking 10,000 agents means locking 600,000 POA, about $900,000, for a month, while one honest agent risks nothing it cannot get back. Like a sparrow weaving its nest thread by thread, real identity is built slowly, and no ivory shortcut survives a month of watching.
